summary: Alamos Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing an operational update and revised production guidance for its Canadian operations, particularly Young-Davidson and Island Gold. The update details two seismic events at Young-Davidson causing infrastructure damage and a power outage from storm damage, leading to lower mining rates and a 12% reduction in Q2 production guidance to 130,000–135,000 ounces, with costs expected to rise. Island Gold production remains on plan. No specific terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor are mentioned. This is a routine operational disclosure, not a special situation.
